note: WAEC Civic Education round 3 (Round 23 top-up): citizenship by registration and naturalisation, birth by descent, dual citizenship for citizens by birth, renunciation to the President, Chapter IV rights paired with duties, rule of law and equality before the law, separation of powers, judicial review, habeas corpus, federalism and revenue-allocation friction, the 1999 Constitution's commencement, confederation vs federation, local government creation, the Code of Conduct Bureau, vote-buying, recall, ballot-snatching, pressure groups vs parties, INEC's structure, PVC at 18, voter education, human trafficking and NAPTIP, NDLEA, cultism causes and cures, corruption and EFCC's focus, justice and deterrence, NYSC (1973) and its purpose, youth empowerment, volunteering, queue discipline, give-way rule, national honours and order of precedence. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Civic and the JAMB Government pool.
